command: pre-registration: F6O, F6 memory with a physical occluder (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 45.5)

metrics.design: Two identical opaque non-colliding cylinder covers (radius .1135 m, top 8 mm above the plate), in the scene in every condition. a visible: both parked. b occluded-late: cover 0 moves onto the plate at env step WAIT+HIDE_AT (after the first query sees the plate). c never-visible: cover 0 on the plate from step 0. d moved-beside: cover 0 moves at b's step to a spot right beside the plate (ring just outside it, about as far from the bowl as the plate) that leaves plate and bowl visible (render check job 4697889: 0 violations; d keeps >= .99 of a's plate pixels at every query in both cameras and 1.0 of the bowl's). Physics identical across conditions. Reference = fx's frozen-plate servo / P_min (better system, fx tid 0 fam, 2 disp).
metrics.headline_layout: disp. In fam the cover on the plate also hides most of the bowl (bowl agentview px c/a .07-.49), so fam is descriptive only (same mapping, not read as a verdict).
metrics.mapping: experiments/f6o_read.py as hashed. Per model and layout, first matching row: NO POWER iff s(a) < .50 or reference < .60; MEMORY ABSENT iff s(d) - s(b) > .10 with CI lower bound > 0 and s(b) - s(c) CI upper bound < .10; MEMORY USED iff s(b) - s(c) > .10 with CI lower bound > 0; else PARTIAL. Paired over states, bootstrap B = 2,000, seed 0. s(a) - s(d) reported as the disc-appearance cost, no verdict. F6 HOLDS iff MEMORY ABSENT on disp for both pi0.5 and GR00T.
metrics.prediction: F6 HOLDS (written before the smoke was read): on disp both VLAs succeed in a and d (pi0.5 near 1.0, GR00T near fx's disp_vis .65), fail in b about as often as in c, and carry the bowl to the plate's training spot in failed b/c episodes; disc cost a - d within .10. fam (descriptive): b and c low as the bowl is hidden too.
metrics.seen: Smoke on states 0-3 (read job 4698476, .claude_tmp/pp/f6o_read_smoke.json), read after the prediction was written; nothing in the mapping changed after it. disp: pi0.5 a 1.0 b .25 c .25 d 1.0 (MEMORY ABSENT); GR00T a .50 b 0 c 0 d .25 (PARTIAL); reference .75 (P_min). fam: pi0.5 a 1.0 b/c/d .75; GR00T a 1.0 b 0 c 0 d 1.0. Failed b/c bowls end near the true plate, never at the training spot. The client's in-rollout track shows the plate with pixels at 16-55% of later b/c queries (the policy disturbs the plate or the wrist camera reaches the cover; the cover does not follow the plate): a leak toward b, reported, no design change.
